description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 005 are swimming pool wall tiles in a turquoise shade for lining the inside walls of a pool, shown in the product photo in a home pool with a steel ladder.

## How they look
The scene photo shows turquoise walls meeting clear water, with a steel ladder fixed to the side. Turquoise pool wall tiles keep the water bright and make the pool look clean and inviting from the deck, which suits a garden or rooftop setting.

## Where they work
- **Inner pool walls**, from the floor up to the waterline, with a border band above if you want one.
- **Pool ladder area tiles**, where the wall around the ladder fixings gets the most wear and needs a surface that is easy to brush.
- **Residential pool tiles** for houses, farmhouses and small clubs that want one calm colour.

Walls are where most algae and waterline marks show, so a mid-light colour that is easy to inspect tends to make maintenance simpler.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: turquoise wall lining (from a pool scene photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; the sales team confirms them with your quote.

Plan ladder and light fittings before tiling so the tiles are cut neatly around them, and use a pool-grade adhesive and grout. Brush the walls regularly to keep the shade clean.

## See it before you order
See the range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and send your wall area and city for a dated quote. Add [blue and white border tiles](/products/swimming-pool-border-tiles) at the waterline, or browse the [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of swimming pool wall tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can the same tile go on pool walls and the floor?
faqs.a: Often yes, and one tile throughout gives an even colour. Some owners use a slightly darker or textured tile on the floor and steps for contrast and grip; ask the team which suits your design.

faqs.q: How do I keep pool wall tiles clean?
faqs.a: Brush the walls and waterline regularly, keep the water chemistry balanced and clean scum off the waterline before it hardens. Avoid harsh acids that can damage grout.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
